title: sluiceway.yaml
description: Configuration of Sluiceway. The file is optional and sits at the repo root.

title.description: Title of the dashboard issue. Every scan puts it back when it differs.

label.description: Label the dashboard issue is found by.

pin.description: Pin the dashboard issue on every scan when it is not pinned, best effort. false keeps it unpinned.

redact.description: Keep resource types, resource names and property names out of the issue. The summary stays full. Not access control.

personality.description: Show the header image and use the voice. false removes both.

readOnly.description: Draw no boxes: pending rows have none, there is no rescan box, and a line under the Pending heading says so. For a workflow that only scans.

showValues.description: Property paths whose old and new value may appear on the dashboard, as "old → new". Exact paths, or "*" for part of one name. Never a value the tool marks secret, and none at all with redact on.

recentlyDeployed.description: How many deploys the Recently deployed list shows, newest first, failed ones included. 0 leaves the list out.

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone every time on the dashboard is shown in, such as Europe/Brussels. A time that stands alone says its offset from UTC, and the line under Recently deployed names the zone. The markers keep UTC.

tickers.description: Default tick rule: write, maintain, admin, or a list of usernames. A list narrows and never widens: a person on it still needs write access.

deploys.description: false stops every deploy: resolve clears every ticked box with a note and starts nothing, and apply ends a deploy that was already started before the tool runs. Scans go on.

days.description: The days of the week the window is on, in full and in lower case: monday to sunday.

from.description: When the window opens on each of those days, as HH:MM on a 24 hour clock in the dashboard zone.

to.description: When it closes, as HH:MM, after from. 24:00 is the end of the day.

deployWindows.description: When the stacks of this repo may go out, in the dashboard zone: a list of windows, each with days of the week, a start and an end. A tick outside every window waits for the next one to open, and so does a deploy on merge. Empty, the default, is any time. A stacks entry sets its own with stacks[].deployWindows.

glob.description: Glob matched against the stack id.

reason.description: Why these stacks are left out. Shown on the dashboard under In sync.

ignore.description: Globs matched against the stack id. An ignored stack has no row. An entry with a reason is listed with it under In sync.

unrelated.description: Globs for files that claim nothing and force nothing, such as **/*.md.

logDiff.description: Print the tool's own diff of every pending stack, values included, in that stack's group of the job log and nowhere else. Anyone who can read the repo can read its job logs. Costs one more tool run per pending stack.

enabled.description: Check every stack for drift in each scan that a schedule starts, or that a person starts with Run workflow: changes made to real infrastructure outside the code. A stack with drift gets a row with a box, and a tick deploys the code as it is, which puts it back. Costs one more tool run per stack in those scans.

valueFingerprint.description: Cover the values a row does not show with a fingerprint on the row, so a tick approves them too: a value that changed between the tick and the deploy stops the deploy, and the row says so without naming the value. A value the tool marks secret never reaches the fingerprint. Turn it off, here or per stack, where a program makes a value that differs on every run.

policies.description: Directories or files of Rego policies, relative to the repo root, that every pending stack's preview is tested against with conftest, which the workflow installs. A policy that fails takes the box off the row until it passes and stops a deploy on merge. Empty runs nothing.

lookback.description: How many of the newest commits a job walks to say which pull requests made a row pending. A stack whose last deploy lies further back gets a line that says earlier changes exist. Each 100 commits cost one more GraphQL request.

names.description: How many pull requests and direct pushes a row and a line of Recently deployed name, newest first. The rest is a count. 0 names none and always counts.

phases.description: Names of the phases stacks deploy in, in order. A stack in a phase depends on every stack in every earlier phase.

path.description: Directory of the stack, relative to the repo root.

name.description: Name of the stack. Without it the entry covers every stack in path.

tool.description: The tool of a stack that discovery cannot find from files alone. The entry then declares the stack at path. opentofu and terraform: a root module, or with the wrapper option a Terragrunt unit or a CDK for Terraform app. helm: a release in a namespace. kubectl: a directory of Kubernetes manifests or a kustomization.

id.description: The id of the one stack this entry covers, in place of the one derived from its path and name. A stack that moved keeps its row and its deploys under it. Unique among every stack id.

environment.description: Label on the deployment record, and the GitHub Environment where one is used. Default: sluiceway.

tickers.description: Tick rule for this stack. Default: the top level tickers.

inputs.description: Extra globs this stack claims, relative to the repo root.

previewTimeout.description: Time limit for one preview of this stack, in whole minutes. Default: the preview-timeout input.

dependsOn.description: Stack ids of the stacks this stack depends on, or auto to read them from the program's stack references at each preview. A tick on this stack is refused while one of them has a change waiting, and when both are ticked they deploy in order.

from.description: A key of the project file whose text is the phase, under config or at the top level.

phase.description: The phase of these stacks, one of phases, or from: a key of the project file that names it. A stack in a phase depends on every stack in every earlier phase.

deploy.description: When these stacks deploy. on-tick: when a person ticks the row, the default. on-merge: by themselves after the scan of a merge that found them pending, through the same fresh preview and hash check as a tick, attributed to whoever merged. A change that deletes or replaces something, drift, and a stack it depends on that waits for a tick still wait for a tick.

days.description: The days of the week the window is on, in full and in lower case: monday to sunday.

from.description: When the window opens on each of those days, as HH:MM on a 24 hour clock in the dashboard zone.

to.description: When it closes, as HH:MM, after from. 24:00 is the end of the day.

deployWindows.description: When these stacks may go out, in place of the top level deployWindows. An empty list lets them go out at any time.

enabled.description: Check these stacks for drift, or not, whatever drift.enabled at the top level says. The scans that check are the same.

drift.description: The drift check of these stacks. Default: the top level drift.

valueFingerprint.description: Cover the values these stacks' rows do not show with a fingerprint, or not, whatever valueFingerprint at the top level says. Turn it off for a stack whose program makes a value that differs on every run. Default: the top level valueFingerprint.

envFile.description: A file of NAME=value lines, relative to the repo root or absolute, that the tool gets for these stacks alone, on top of the job environment and the step's env-file input. Every value is masked first. A file that cannot be loaded fails the preview of these stacks and no other.

policies.description: Directories or files of Rego policies these stacks are tested against, relative to the repo root, on top of the top level policies.

createInBackend.description: true: a scan creates each Pulumi stack of the entry that the backend lacks, with pulumi stack init right before its first preview, and previews it as all creates. A deploy never creates a stack. Default: false.

options.description: Named adapter options of the tool. Only an entry with tool takes them.

workspace.description: opentofu and terraform: The workspace of the stack, selected with TF_WORKSPACE for every command. Without it, the one the environment selects, which is default.

varFiles.description: opentofu and terraform: Var files, relative to the directory of the stack, passed with -var-file in this order to every plan. Not with a wrapper.

wrapper.description: opentofu and terraform: What stands in front of the tool. terragrunt: path is one Terragrunt unit, and terragrunt runs the tool there. cdktf: path is a CDK for Terraform app, cdktf synth writes its stacks, and name picks the one this entry deploys.

release.description: helm: The name of the Helm release. Helm's rule: lower case letters, digits, - and .

namespace.description: helm: The namespace of the release, passed with --namespace to every command. kubectl: The namespace of objects that name none, passed with --namespace to every command. Without it, the namespace of the context.

chart.description: helm: The chart: a path relative to the directory of the stack that starts with "./" or "../", or a chart reference such as repo/name or oci://registry/name.

version.description: helm: The exact version of a chart reference. A local chart takes none.

valuesFiles.description: helm: Values files, relative to the directory of the stack, passed with --values in this order to every command.

createNamespace.description: helm: Create the namespace of the release when it is not there, with --create-namespace on the deploy. The preview works without it.

context.description: kubectl: The kubeconfig context of the stack, passed with --context to every command. Without it, the current context of the kubeconfig.

recursive.description: kubectl: Read the manifests of every subdirectory too, as kubectl apply -R does. Only for a directory of manifests. Default false: one level.

prune.description: kubectl: Delete an object taken out of the manifests when the stack deploys, and show it as a delete on the row. Sluiceway keeps the list of the stack's objects in a ConfigMap next to them. Default false.

forceConflicts.description: kubectl: Take a field that another field manager holds, with --force-conflicts on the preview and the deploy. Without it such a field fails the preview. Default false.

fieldManager.description: kubectl: The field manager of the preview and the deploy, passed with --field-manager. Without it, kubectl's own, kubectl.

stacks.description: Settings for stacks that discovery found. An entry never creates a stack, except an entry with tool, which declares one.

discovery.description: Switches for what discovery finds on its own. Pulumi stacks are always found.

rootModules.description: Find OpenTofu and Terraform root modules from their files: a directory with a backend or cloud block, a lock file or .tofu files that say which tool runs it, and no other directory using it as a module source. Each is one stack in the default workspace. A directory a stacks entry declares keeps its entry. Default: true.

authors.description: Logins whose open pull requests may be merged and deployed with one tick, such as renovate[bot]. Empty turns it off.

preview.description: Preview the branch of each update waiting to merge, and show what it would change on its row. One extra preview per update on every scan that lists it.

events.description: The events a notification is sent on, to each channel the step's inputs name: pending (stacks newly pending after a scan), drift (stacks newly drifted), deployed, failed and refused (a tick that deployed nothing).
